# Aevion Studio — Elite Technology & AI Systems Studio

We engineer autonomous AI systems, resilient software architectures, high-performance web experiences, and experimental digital products for visionary teams worldwide.

## Core Engineering Disciplines
1. Autonomous AI & Neural Systems:
   - ReAct and Plan-and-Solve agentic workflows
   - Hybrid semantic & keyword RAG with PostgreSQL pgvector
   - Sub-150ms streaming inferences with typed JSON validation
   - Defense-in-depth prompt hardening and injection defense
2. Resilient Software & Cloud Architecture:
   - Type-safe REST and GraphQL serverless microservices
   - PostgreSQL connection pooling and ACID data persistence
   - First-party authentication with cryptographic scrypt hashing
   - Global edge deployment on Vercel Edge infrastructure
3. Immersive WebGL & Creative Engineering:
   - Hardware-accelerated Three.js 3D product visualizers
   - Custom GLSL vertex and fragment shaders
   - Viewport-aware rendering loops with adaptive DPR
   - WCAG accessibility fallbacks conforming to prefers-reduced-motion
4. End-to-End Product Architecture:
   - Production SaaS platforms and developer operating systems
   - High-velocity prototyping with production-grade foundations
   - Direct founder-to-client collaboration with zero agency bloat
5. Real-Time & Streaming Infrastructure:
   - Sub-millisecond WebSockets and Server-Sent Events (SSE)
   - Telemetry monitors and optimistic state synchronization

## Verified Case Studies
- Nilgiris Explorers: Premium eco-tourism portal with sub-second page transitions.
- Ooty Mistwings: Dynamic hospitality booking and guest concierge platform.
- Gaming Kingdom: Real-time esports community hub and tournament registry.
- Aevion Studio OS: Developer-focused internal operating system and workflow engine.
